name: advertising
title: Advertising
summary: Ad placements and their rules, ad campaigns through the full lifecycle, creatives and their review, audiences, schedules, frequency caps and dismissal suppression, rotation and priority, the serving decision for each page view, display/click/dismissal tracking with attribution, and seller sponsored campaigns with spending limits and ad charges kept separate from commission.
owns: Placements: opening full-screen, home and category banners, promotional pop-up, sponsored product, sponsored store or brand, floating/sticky panel, interstitial; video later

Global rules: never cover checkout, payment results, tracking or returns; one overlay at a time; required Ad/Sponsored labels; visible close control; remove unavailable or expired ads; seller behind promoted offers named
Per-placement page eligibility, formats, frequency caps, rotation or priority rule and dismissal suppression

Ad campaigns: advertiser (own promotion, Official Store product, seller, brand), goal, linked promotion, placement, pages, audience, destination, schedule with publication time zone, frequency, priority, delivery cap, budget
Campaign lifecycle: Draft, In review, Approved, Scheduled, Live, Paused, Finished, Archived (plus Rejected)
Approvals: Advertising plus Content or Marketing for own promotions; Advertising review for seller and brand ads
Creative library: desktop and phone images, ad text, optional video, link checks, automatic checks and reviewer notes
Serving: deciding which ads to show on a page view now, honouring rules, audience, caps, suppression and overlay exclusivity
Tracking of displays, clicks and dismissals; attribution of purchases within a stated attribution period; reports
Seller sponsored campaign requests, spending limits (daily and total), billing model and ad charges posted to finance as a separate line
notOwns: Discounts and coupons a campaign links to: promotions (the ad brings attention; the promotion changes the price)
Homepage section order and campaign pages: content (ad positions appear there as locked markers)
Seller statements and balances: finance (consumes advertising.charge.posted)
Approval limits and second reviewers: access

stateMachines.name: Ad campaign
stateMachines.notes: Plan ch. 16 lifecycle (Draft → In review/Submitted → Approved → Scheduled → Live/Active ⇄ Paused → Finished → Archived); Rejected is added for requests that fail review. approve completes only when every required ApprovalStep is approved (own promotions: Advertising plus Content or Marketing; seller and brand ads: Advertising, Content for claims). activate is allowed only if startsAt has passed and no linked promotion starts later. The final approve applies the campaign's afterApproval choice automatically (schedule, or activate when still allowed; if activation became impossible meanwhile it falls back to schedule and says so in the timeline). start/finish run from jobs at startsAt/endsAt; finish also fires on budget or delivery cap reached, linked promotion ended (stopWithPromotion), promoted offer unavailable, seller suspended. Staff pause takes the ad off the site within 1 minute (decision ttl). Renew creates a new draft copy; it is not a transition. Editing a seller request in review sends it back to draft (start of review).

stateMachines.name: Creative review
stateMachines.notes: Creatives are submitted with their campaign. approve needs every required reviewer role. revoke is used when a promoted offer is suspended or a trust enforcement names it (reason recorded; seller can appeal through trust). reinstate only follows trust.enforcement.reversed for a creative that enforcement revoked: it goes back to review, never straight to approved.

stateMachines.name: Ad charge
stateMachines.notes: Charges accrue per day from billable clicks/displays or the fixed daily fee and are capped at the daily and total limits. post sends them to finance (advertising.charge.posted) as an ad-charge line separate from commission. Invalid traffic or staff-cancelled delivery is voided (before posting) or credited (after posting) with a reason. Unused budget is never charged.

endpoints.summary: Decide which ads to show on this page view now
endpoints.desc: Returns nothing for blocked pages (checkout, payment results, tracking, returns) and at most one overlay per page view; skips overlays when one already showed this session where the placement says so. Applies audience (only data the visitor's privacy choices allow), schedule, frequency caps, dismissal suppression, priority and even rotation, availability of promoted offers and linked promotion status. Used by the website and the Android app.

endpoints.summary: Record displays, clicks and dismissals (batched)
endpoints.desc: Each event carries the signed impression token from the decision. A dismissal applies the campaign's suppression rule immediately for the visitor. Duplicate events for the same token and kind are ignored, and so are displays of a campaign that is no longer live. Clicks start the attribution period. A click on a seller's CPC campaign is billed only after the same impression's display was recorded (displays in a batch count first), and at most once per visitor (visitor or session key, and the signed-in customer) per campaign per market day; other clicks are recorded for reports, unbilled.

endpoints.summary: Edit a staff ad (a running ad gets a pending change)
endpoints.desc: Fields left out keep their value; send null to clear. draft and changes_requested: edits the ad. scheduled, live and paused: endsAt applies at once (no review); every other change creates or replaces the pending change (state draft, submitted with POST /ads/{id}/submit) while the current version keeps running. in_review (first review) and a pending change in review: ILLEGAL_TRANSITION until the review is done. ended and rejected: duplicate instead.

endpoints.summary: Send the ad (or its pending change) for the two reviews
endpoints.desc: draft or changes_requested → in_review; on a scheduled, live or paused ad: submits its pending change. Submit checks: a phone image of the placement's size, a description (alt), an available destination, endsAt in the future and at most 90 days after the start (or after now when startsAt is empty). Failed checks are CHECKS_FAILED with details.checks.

endpoints.summary: Approve, request changes or reject the open review step (first review or pending change)
endpoints.desc: The step comes from the caller's access roles (Advertising Manager → advertising, Content or Marketing Manager → content, Business Owner either). The person who created the ad (or the change) reviews neither step, and one person cannot take both (SAME_REVIEWER). A note is required to request changes or reject. Last approval of the first review: scheduled for startsAt, or live at once when startsAt is empty or past. Last approval of a change: the change replaces the live version (images, destination, name, alt, start, deal) and the pending change is cleared. Request changes on a change: the change goes back to its author (state changes_requested). Reject of a change: the change is dropped and the live version keeps running; reject of a first review: the ad is rejected.

step.desc: Only when the caller holds both reviewing roles

consumes.name: orders.order.placed
consumes.does: Attribute the order to the last ad click within attributionDays: by customerId for signed-in shoppers, and for guests by the payload visitorId (present only when the shopper allowed personalization; hashed like ad_events.visitor_key). Orders with neither are not attributed. unique (order_id, campaign_id) keeps redelivery idempotent

consumes.name: orders.item.cancelled
consumes.does: Reduce attributed sales for cancelled items

consumes.name: content.page.published
consumes.does: Re-run link checks for creatives pointing at the page

consumes.name: access.approval.decided
consumes.does: Apply an approved global rules change at its effective time (and finish non-draft fee schedule approvals). Inbox-claimed per event (ctx.mongo.claim) before acting, so a redelivered decision applies once and writes one audit entry

consumes.name: catalog.product.merged
consumes.does: Repoint ads, ad requests and creatives that promote the duplicate product (or its variants, mapped through newVariantId / intoVariantId) to the kept product; delivery, spend and attribution history stay on the ad

Create, edit, submit, renew and archive campaigns; manage creatives
Approve, request changes or reject campaigns and creatives (Advertising, Content, Marketing reviewers)
Schedule, activate, pause, resume and finish campaigns
Propose global rule changes (always approved by the Business Owner)
View seller ad charges; void or credit them within limits

approvalActions.desc: Change the versioned global advertising rules (frequency, overlays per page, labels, paid seller ads)
Void or credit a seller ad charge
approvalActions.approvers: Advertising Manager within the adjustment limit; Finance Manager above it (example values)

jobs.name: advertising.finish-due
jobs.does: Live or paused campaigns past endsAt → finished; finish when delivery cap reached

jobs.name: advertising.availability-sweep
jobs.does: Pause ads for unavailable or low-stock promoted offers and inactive linked promotions; resume when available again

jobs.name: advertising.link-check
jobs.does: Re-check destination links and promoted-offer availability for approved and live creatives

jobs.name: advertising.accrue-charges
jobs.does: Accrue billable clicks/displays and fixed daily fees of campaigns the seller requested, capped at daily and total limits; stop delivery at the limit

jobs.name: advertising.post-charges
jobs.does: Post the previous day's charges to finance (advertising.charge.posted), only while paid seller ads are on. A charge of a campaign the seller did not request is voided with the reason instead and never posted

jobs.name: advertising.expire-frequency-state
jobs.does: Delete frequency and suppression rows past their window

jobs.name: advertising.prune-events
jobs.does: Delete ad_events older than eventRetentionMonths (daily_stats keep the totals; attribution looks back at most 30 days)

jobs.name: advertising.ending-soon-notice
jobs.does: Publish advertising.campaign.ending_soon for campaigns ending within endingSoonDays (once per campaign), so owners finish or renew deliberately

PLACEMENT_DISABLED.meaning: The placement is off or belongs to a later phase.

PAGE_NOT_ELIGIBLE.meaning: A selected page is not eligible for the placement or is blocked by the global rules (checkout, payment results, tracking, returns).

CHECKS_FAILED.meaning: Required checks failed (missing label, broken link, promoted offer unavailable, missing phone or desktop creative). details.checks.

SAME_REVIEWER.meaning: The same person cannot approve two required review steps, and the campaign creator approves none.

PROMOTION_NOT_STARTED.meaning: The linked promotion has not started; schedule instead of activating.

AD_UNAVAILABLE.meaning: The promoted offer is unavailable or the linked promotion is inactive.

CREATIVE_FORMAT_INVALID.meaning: Size, dimensions, file type or text length does not match the placement format.

INVALID_IMPRESSION_TOKEN.meaning: The tracking token is missing, expired or tampered with.

PAID_ADS_DISABLED.meaning: Paid seller advertising is not enabled yet.

SLOT_FULL.meaning: The carousel already has its most live ads (Placement.maxPerPage); schedule the ad instead: it starts when one ends.

OFFER_NOT_PROMOTABLE.meaning: The offer is not the seller's, not active or out of stock.

notes: Page types (a plain string everywhere: public API page arguments, ServeRequest.page, placement eligiblePages, campaign pages): home, category, search, product, campaign, collection, deals, brand, seller_store, official_store, cart, checkout, payment_result, order_tracking, returns, account, help, companies, play, software, food (the app’s Companies, Play center, Softwares and Food delivery department pages). checkout, payment_result, order_tracking and returns are always blocked; global rules may block more.

Frequency counters live on frequency_state per visitor key and campaign: session_displays (this session), window_displays from window_started_at (perWindow, or a rolling day for perDay alone), day_displays for the market day display_day (perDay together with perWindow) and total_displays (perCampaign). Rows of a live campaign with a perCampaign cap are kept until the campaign ends, so the total never resets.
Promotions change the offer; ads bring attention to it (plan ch. 16). An ad may link a promotion; claims in creatives are checked against it.

Serving order per page view: drop blocked pages → candidate campaigns live now for this placement, page and audience → drop suppressed (dismissed) and frequency-capped → drop unavailable promoted offers → pick by priority, equal priority rotates evenly (sponsored products: relevance first). Overlays: at most overlaysPerPageView, and a pop-up is skipped in a session where an opening ad showed.

Opening full-screen ads: separate desktop and phone creatives, entry pages only, default once per session and configurable per campaign; closing returns the visitor to the page they opened (acceptance scenario 8).

Targeting uses only first-party information the visitor's privacy choices allow (region, new/returning, signed-in, browsing categories in this store). When personalizationAllowed is false only page context is used.

Ad charges are a seller cost separate from sales commission; finance shows them as their own statement line. Unused budget is never charged; if Marketly pauses or cancels, only delivery so far is charged. Paid campaigns never imply guaranteed purchases.

Paid seller ads, sponsored store/brand, floating, interstitial and video are later (plan ch. 20 phase 3); their seller endpoints are phase 3 and the placements ship disabled. Sponsored product runs as a pilot for selected sellers when paidSellerAdsEnabled is on.

Dependencies follow the architecture doc (media, access). promotions, offers, inventory, catalog, sellers, orders and content are optional: without them the related checks are skipped and the matching auto-pause rules do nothing.
Global rules changes are versioned with an effective date and always need Business Owner approval (admin/ad-placements); the four blocked page types can never be unblocked.

Reviewer roles: approve, request-changes and creative review take the reviewing step from the caller's access roles (access.rolesOf), so a Content Manager can never act on the Advertising step by sending role advertising.

Attribution privacy (decision: guest attribution only with personalizationAllowed): orders carry visitorId only when the shopper allowed personalization; clicks recorded without personalization keep no visitor key usable for attribution.

Staff ads (GET/POST /ads…, owner decision 2026-10-23): the simple Advertisements page. A staff ad is an own (platform) campaign with one placement, a phone image creative (plus an optional website image for opening_fullscreen), a picked destination resolved to a store path, a schedule, a carousel position and an optional linked deal (linkedPromotionId, stopWithPromotion). It uses the same lifecycle, review steps (advertising + content, never the creator, never one person for both), jobs, serving and stats as every campaign; the campaign endpoints keep working on the same records. Slots: Full-screen (opening_fullscreen), Home carousel (home_banner), Departments (software_top, food_top, companies_top, play_top), Deals (deals_top), Other (category_banner, popup).

Pending change: editing a scheduled, live or paused staff ad saves the edit as campaigns.pending_change and the current version keeps serving. Submitting it opens a new review submission (approval_steps.submission); the last approval applies it (new creatives replace the old ones, destination, name, alt, start and deal are copied) and clears it; reject drops it. End date and carousel position never need review.

Carousel order: carousel placements (rotation mode carousel) serve their ads by campaigns.position (1 first), then by creation. Every staff ad gets the next position of its placement when created; PUT /ads/order rewrites the order of the live and scheduled ones.

Destinations are picked (AdDestinationInput) and resolved server-side to app store paths through the owning modules' linkTargets public API: product /p/{slug}/{id}, category /c/{slug}, department /phones, /farm-machines, /software, /welfare, /food, /booking, /blogs, /companies, /play, /rewards, restaurant /food/restaurants/{slug}, deal /deals?campaign={id}, collection /collection/{slug}, seller_store /shop/{slug} (Official Store /official), brand /brand/{slug}, phone /phones/{slug}; url is kept as typed (https, or a store path). Promoted-offer impressions open /p/{slug}/{productId}?offer={offerId}.

Links saved before the pickers (kind url and the wizard's kinds) are read as the target their store path names (and converted by the 2026-10-23 destinations migration): /p/{slug}/{id} and /product/{id} product; /c/{slug} category; /pages, /collections and /collection/{slug} collection; /deals the Deals tab (kind deal, targetId tab) and /deals?campaign={id} a deal; the ten department paths (and the old /softwares) department; /phones/{slug} phone; /food/restaurants/{slug} restaurant; /shop/{slug} and /official seller_store; /brand/{slug} brand. A slug that is not found keeps its path with available false. Other store paths stay kind url labelled Store page; https addresses are Web address.

Slot settings (2026-10-23): carousel slots show every live ad in position order, each for rotation.carouselSeconds (2–15), with at most maxPerPage live ads (1–20, default 10). An ad that would go live in a full carousel (last approval, its start time, resume) waits as scheduled and starts when one ends (oldest start first); activating one by hand is SLOT_FULL. The single-ad slots (opening_fullscreen, popup, category_banner) let their ads take turns in position order per page view (category banner: ads for the page's category first). Slots on the Advertisements page show on the slot's pages (eligiblePages within pageOptions), not per-ad pages.
deals_top (2026-10-23): a short carousel at the top of the app's Deals tab, phone 750 × 150 (5:1), every live ad in position order, like the department carousels.
